description: This source file defines the StartCVDAction struct and related functions to initiate and manage starting a CVD (Android virtual device) instance within the orchestrator component of the Android Cuttlefish project. It handles parameters, execution, and asynchronous operation completion.

classes.name: StartCVDActionOpts
classes.description: Struct holding options for starting a CVD, including request details, selector, paths, operation manager, execution context, and user.

classes.name: StartCVDAction
classes.description: Struct representing the action to start a CVD instance, encapsulating request data, selector, paths, operation manager, and CLI interface.

methods.name: NewStartCVDAction
methods.description: Constructor function that creates a new StartCVDAction instance with provided options.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Initiates the start operation asynchronously and returns the operation object.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Performs the CVD start process, handling snapshot option and invoking the CLI start method.
